summary: A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocates mark the anniversary of the National Guard deployment to the District and warn against federal actions that would further restrict D.C.'s fiscal autonomy. These developments reflect ongoing advocacy efforts around what supporters describe as federal overreach into D.C.'s governance. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
